def count_words(text: str) -> int:
    """Count words in a note, ignoring comment lines (first non-blank char is '#')."""
    total = 0
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
            continue
        total += len(line.split())
    return total
EOF
cat >> tests/test_wordcount.py <<'EOF'

    assert count_words('  \t# note here\nhello\n') == 1


def test_count_words_hash_not_first_is_not_comment():

def test_count_words_separated_by_any_whitespace_run():
    assert count_words('a  b\tc \t d\ne') == 5


def test_count_words_empty_and_blank():
    assert count_words('') == 0
    assert count_words('  \n\t\n') == 0


def test_count_words_hash_without_space_is_comment():
    assert count_words('#tag one two\nx') == 1
EOF
